expectation: Asking one trader question ("is he early or chasing the news?") under a trader profile answers the edge group: news timing and entry earliness first, then the rest of that group, with the wallet card link.
text: @Lychee_data is he early on his bets or just chasing the news?
parent_text:
This Polymarket trader made $1.7M betting on elections around the world

His name is "gopfan2" (@r_gopfan) and he joined Polymarket in August 2024

His edge: elections in countries most traders don't follow closely

His biggest win is $203,073:
> he bought "Mark Carney to be the next Canadian PM" at ~55c

Other big wins:
> United Russia wins most seats in the Russian parliamentary election - $141K (77c)
> Karol Nawrocki becomes President of Poland - $128K (64c)
> AfD wins 20-25% in the German election - $111K (24c)
> Bhumjaithai wins most seats in Thailand - $80K (bought at 6c)
> Zohran Mamdani wins NYC mayor - $89K (87c)

Not every bet works: he is down about $21K on Gavin Newsom winning in 2028

But $1.7M profit on $70.8M volume shows what one niche can do
